article: Art. LXIV — superseded implementations retire in the same change that ships their replacement; deletion is accounted, never silent
directive: AM11 §4 + owner message direction 4/5 (2026-11-15): consolidate duplicate A1 sets to ONE authoritative grounded set (r11_a1f_r1); retire r11_a1_r5 / r11_a1_fresh_r10; delete the duplicate answer sets after consolidation; nothing else new

authoritative_sets.r11_a1f_r1: AUTHORITATIVE GROUNDED SET — 30 SYS_A1F answers (GLM generator, full bytes + provenance), the A arm of the audited battery r7 (eval/battery_a1f_r7.json, AM11 gate input: novelty delta 0.967 unresolved, feasibility gap 1.333 resolved-FAIL) and the AM11 D3 auditor per-axis re-judgment input
authoritative_sets.r11_a1f_r2: THE AM11 D1 (F30) FEASIBILITY-AWARE ARM — 30 SYS_A1F_V2 answers (orthogonality contract: novelty in the observable, feasibility in the implementation, burden ledger), generated and committed 8531c54eb + sofc repair bafe163d9 (24 CLEAN / 6 FLAG / 0 KILL after repair); the battery r8 measurement input, pending a live judge route
authoritative_sets.r11_a1_r3 + r11_a1_r3_grounded: KEPT_BECAUSE historical delivery bytes — the committed A arm of battery_peraxis_r11_r6.json (PROMOTED_DELIVERY_r11_a1_r3, 12 rows); battery r6 is superseded by battery r7 but its record stays re-runnable from these committed inputs
authoritative_sets.r11_a1, r11_a1_r2, r11_a1_r3_superseded: KEPT_BECAUSE pre-F29 history (the 1.0.0/1.2.0 pipeline lineage documented in pipeline_retirement_r11.json); outside the AM11 retirement mandate (nothing else new)

r11_a1_r5.was: 30 GLM raw A1 regenerations (arm_source=GLM_REGENERATION_r11_a1_r5), committed ceffc7b6e as the F29 fix (full re-judgeable bytes replacing the mistral-14b confound)
r11_a1_r5.measured_as_battery_arm: NEVER — no committed battery lists r11_a1_r5 bytes as an A arm (verified: battery r4/r5 mistral arms; battery r6 = r11_a1_r3 + mistral fresh; battery r7 = r11_a1f_r1)
r11_a1_r5.superseded_by: eval/pairs/r11_a1f_r1 (the authoritative grounded set — the AM11 gate battery input)

r11_a1_fresh_r10.was: 18 fresh-problem GLM answers (a1_source=GLM_CURATED_R10_REGEN, SYS_A1_GROUNDED), committed 4e755c1e7/e6d9b114d as the fresh half of the F29 fix
r11_a1_fresh_r10.measured_as_battery_arm: NEVER as committed bytes — the r6 battery's fresh 18 were the mistral-14b confound arms (BATTERY_R5_FRESH_GEN_mistral14b_SYS_A1); the r7 per-axis driver listed this dir as an input but never produced battery_peraxis_r11_r7.json (superseded by the a1f battery path before it ran)

scripts/r10_battery_peraxis_r7.py.was: the AM10 D5 per-axis re-judgment driver (A arm = r11_a1_r3_grounded + r11_a1_fresh_r10 vs curated baselines, calibrated suffix) — a RUNS-WHEN-JUDGE-LIVE driver
scripts/r10_battery_peraxis_r7.py.why_retired: its A-arm input r11_a1_fresh_r10 is retired by this change (a live driver may not point at deleted bytes), and its function — per-axis measurement of the authoritative grounded set vs curated baselines with the calibrated k=3 judge — is fully carried by scripts/r11_battery_a1f_r7.py, which ALREADY produced the committed audited measurement (eval/battery_a1f_r7.json)
scripts/r10_battery_peraxis_r7.py.referenced_by: nothing (verified: no test, no script imports it)

kept_historical_scripts.scripts/r11_commit_a1_r5.py, scripts/r10: KEPT_BECAUSE one-shot provenance instruments of the F29 closure (they document HOW the retired bytes were made; they are not live drivers, they are not re-run, and the F29 closure evidence cites them). Their outputs are retired; the scripts stay as history (Art. XI). Status: HISTORICAL_ONE_SHOT.
kept_historical_scripts.eval/r10_status_r11.json, eval/r10_stage: KEPT_BECAUSE round-status narrative records that mention the retired paths as history (Art. XI — history is evidence; narrative records are not rewritten)

acceptance: single authoritative grounded set (r11_a1f_r1) + the D1 arm (r11_a1f_r2); duplicates retired and deleted with per-file sha256 accounting; no battery, problem, judge, baseline, or calibration bytes touched (Art. LXXIX)
disclosure: this session's own duplicate generation race: an independent builder session (this one) regenerated eval/pairs/r11_a1f_r2 in ignorance of the parallel session's 08:02:26Z push (same contract, different draws: this session's batch had a fu-001 KILL, the parallel batch a sofc KILL); the parallel session's pushed-first bytes are authoritative (Art.
